description: This file defines functions for constructing session hook payloads and managing session context in a plugin-based system, related to session start and end events in an OpenClaw application.

methods.name: function buildSessionHookContext(params: { buildSessionHookContext
methods.description: Constructs a session context object containing session ID, session key, and agent ID based on provided parameters.

methods.name: export function buildSessionStartHookPayload(params: { buildSessionStartHookPayload
methods.description: Builds a payload object for session start events, including session details and context.

methods.name: export function buildSessionEndHookPayload(params: { buildSessionEndHookPayload
methods.description: Builds a payload object for session end events, including session details, reason, message count, duration, and context.
